checked_boundaries: Applied product diff consists of one graph-only helper and file-local fallback; shared manager string parser and consumers remain unchanged.
Original blank/include/directive/literal space-at-space routes are selected before comment fallback; the complete original ordinary parse wins.
First ASCII space or tab followed by hash selects the prefix; invalid or URL prefixes retain original diagnostic and no later delimiter search.
Captured lines are split once; any rstrip terminal backslash vetoes fallback for that file without revoking original success or affecting a different captured file.
Existing declaration constructor retains canonical names, exact-version interpretation and physical path/line.
No new reader/probe/root/edge/depth change and no closure/frontier/credit priority edits; existing graph computations consume new declaration events.
bounded_cost: Eligible failed ordinary lines incur prefix validation and reuse of the existing constructor; no extra file read.
review_scope: Read-only product/spec diff and prior patch review plus frozen focused core GREEN; no full gate, archive, CI, or source edits.
